sources.title: Holomorphic anomalies, fourfolds and fluxes

sources.title: Twisted 6d (2, 0) SCFTs on a circle

sources.title: Liouville Correlation Functions from Four-dimensional Gauge Theories

evidence.text: Use Ω-deformed localization on R4. U(2) fixed instantons are labeled by pairs of Young diagrams, weighted by powers of the exponentiated UV coupling and vector/hypermultiplet factors. Split Z_full into classical, one-loop and instanton pieces.

sources.title: A-D-E Classification of Conformal Field Theories

evidence.text: Reduce torus modular invariance to the finite matrix equations SNS† = TNT† = N, imposing entrywise nonnegative integer multiplicities and N11=1. The affine sl(2) proof described first finds invariant sesquilinear forms without positivity and then selects the admissible coefficients.

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: The Fixed Wilson lines algorithm adds candidate roots to a rank-16 subgroup and solves for E_ij; it misses 3A6 and A3+A6+A9. The Neighborhood algorithm replaces one root of a known maximal enhancement while preserving the others, allowing those missing enhancements.

sources.title: Averaging over moduli in deformed WZW models

sources.title: Duality origami: Emergent ensemble symmetries in holography and Swampland

evidence.text: Treat the sector label as part of the bundle of partition functions over moduli space, pass to the subgroup that fixes that label, and normalize the corresponding moduli integral by the cover's volume.

sources.title: Abelian varieties, RCFTs, attractors, and Hitchin functional in two dimensions

evidence.text: Use period matrices and the Riemann bilinear identity; eliminate K and λ to obtain an induced-area action. Vary exact parts in ζ = [ζ] + dξ while holding cohomology fixed, producing harmonic-form equations.
